# Shellback, the armoured creep: an indigo dome shell with a lilac rim, a grey-teal head and four stubby
# legs. 0.7 x 0.84 x 0.5 m. make_env.py.
new
material new Shell --base-color 0.4000 0.3765 0.5725 --no-slot
material new Rim --base-color 0.6471 0.5765 0.6471 --no-slot
material new Skin --base-color 0.4941 0.6196 0.6000 --no-slot
material new Foot --base-color 0.3647 0.4078 0.4471 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Dome --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.3300 --location 0 0 0
set rotation 0.0 0.0 0.0
apply --rotation
scale 1.000 1.150 0.850
apply --scale
translate 0.0000 -0.0300 0.2000
material assign Shell
add mesh cylinder --vertices 8 --radius 0.3600 --depth 0.1000 --name Rim --location 0 0 0
set rotation 0 0 22.5
apply --rotation
translate 0.0000 -0.0300 0.1700
material assign Rim
add mesh cube --name Head --size 1 --location 0.0000 -0.3600 0.2000
scale 0.2000 0.1800 0.1700
apply --scale
material assign Skin
add mesh cube --name Leg0 --size 1 --location -0.2400 -0.2000 0.0600
scale 0.1300 0.1300 0.1200
apply --scale
material assign Foot
add mesh cube --name Leg1 --size 1 --location 0.2400 -0.2000 0.0600
scale 0.1300 0.1300 0.1200
apply --scale
material assign Foot
add mesh cube --name Leg2 --size 1 --location -0.2400 0.2000 0.0600
scale 0.1300 0.1300 0.1200
apply --scale
material assign Foot
add mesh cube --name Leg3 --size 1 --location 0.2400 0.2000 0.0600
scale 0.1300 0.1300 0.1200
apply --scale
material assign Foot
select all
shade flat
export shell.glb
